refsection.title: Description
refsection.para:
The `SilikoLexerGetToken` function gets the current token from the lexer.
* `Lexer` is the `SilikoLexer` object from which to retrieve the token.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: A SilikoToken object representing the curent token. If the `Type` property of the return value is `SILIKO_TOK_ID`, the `Id` will be a pointer to a string that is owned by the `Lexer`, and will only be available until the next time `SilikoTokenNext` is called on `Lexer`. If the `Type` property of the return value is `SILIKO_TOK_EOL`, then further calls to `SilikoLexerNext` will have no effect on `Lexer`.
